content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PRL Udaipur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Physical Research Laboratory Udaipur Solar Observatory (PRL Udaipur) is conducting this recruitment drive for various traineeship positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PRL Udaipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for different posts including Telescope Operator Trainee, Office Trainee, and Hindi Translator Trainee.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PRL Udaipur posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 14-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit their documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PRL Udaipur Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply via email by sending their filled-out application form and scanned documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Telescope Operator Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Electronics & Communications / Electrical / Mechanical, BE/B.Tech, or M.Sc. in Physics/Electronics with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Office Trainee?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Office Trainee position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 23,500 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for any of the advertised positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for Hindi Translator Trainee?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Hindi Translator Trainee post ranges from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 35 years.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for PRL Udaipur Trainees?
faq.answer: The selection process generally comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by a skill test as prescribed by the organization.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF directly from the official website www.prl.res.in or by using the important links provided in this article.
